rationale: The candidate directly and correctly identifies `cmd.Flag(name)` as the retrieval mechanism and safely handles a nil result before reading `f.Value`. This is supported by `command.go:1794-1803`, whose comment says `Flag` climbs the command tree and whose implementation returns the matching `*flag.Flag`, and by `command.go:1641-1653`, which says `Flags()` includes persistent flags declared by all parents.
